experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/stages.html#experimental)
[![pkgdown](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-pkgdown-blue.svg)](https://dataniel.github.io/daos)

> **Experimental.** This package is a personal collection of utility
> functions that have grown out of day-to-day statistical work: things I
> kept wishing R had out of the box, patterns I found myself repeating,
> and new ideas I wanted to try out. Rather than letting them accumulate
> as loose scripts, I packaged them up properly with the help of Claude
> Code to get a solid starting point: documentation, tests, and a
> vignette from the start. Consider it a living experiment.

## Related packages

Five bodies of work grew large enough to leave and become packages of
their own. They are standalone — none of them depends on `daos`, or
`daos` on them.

| Package                                          | What it does                                                                                           |
|--------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| [taskr](https://github.com/dataniel/taskr)       | Taskwarrior-style task management backed by a shared SQLite file                                       |
| [statbank](https://github.com/dataniel/statbank) | Client and keyboard browser for the Greenland and Faroese statbanks                                    |
| [cvrr](https://github.com/dataniel/cvrr)         | Published Danish annual reports: the CVR distribution service, XBRL, and sign reconciliation           |
| [taxmill](https://github.com/dataniel/taxmill)   | PDF financial statements milled into a tidy Excel dataset, locally                                     |
| [pathr](https://github.com/dataniel/pathr)       | Frictionless file paths: a file browser, open-in-explorer, and RStudio addins for pasted Windows paths |

## Installation

``` r
pak::pak("dataniel/daos")
```

## What it looks like

**Reading a set of files.**
[`read_files()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/read_files.md)
replaces the usual
[`list.files()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/list.files.html) + loop + naming
pipeline with one call that expands paths, checks they exist, detects
the format, and names the results.

``` r
library(daos)

# One file returns the object; several return a named list
df  <- read_files("data/results.parquet")
lst <- read_files("data/dat{0:9}.parquet", names = 0:9)

# Or row-bind them, keeping track of where each row came from
panel <- read_files(
  "data/dat{2020:2024}.parquet",
  names = 2020:2024,
  out   = "bind",
  .id   = "year"
)
```

If it handles a set of files without warnings, the production upstream
is consistent. When it warns about type mismatches, something changed —
and
[`expectr::view_types()`](https://dataniel.github.io/expectr/reference/view_types.html)
shows which column, in which file.

**Checkpoints instead of silent assumptions** now live in their own
package, [expectr](https://github.com/dataniel/expectr):
[`expect_empty()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/moved-to-expectr.md),
[`expect_none()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/moved-to-expectr.md),
[`expect_unique()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/moved-to-expectr.md),
[`expect_balanced()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/moved-to-expectr.md),
[`expect_no_overlap()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/moved-to-expectr.md),
[`tally_violations()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/moved-to-expectr.md),
[`flag_duplicates()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/moved-to-expectr.md)
and
[`view_types()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/moved-to-expectr.md).
daos forwards them, so existing scripts keep working.

``` r
library(expectr)

sales |>
  expect_none(is.na(customer_id), abort_msg = "Sales without a customer id") |>
  expect_unique(order_id)
```

**Danish and Greenlandic identifiers, and a file a colleague can read.**

``` r
customers |>
  dplyr::mutate(cpr = clean_cpr(cpr)) |>   # restores Excel-lost leading zeros
  add_cpr_info(cpr) |>                     # birth date, age, sex, validity
  write_excel(f("customers_{nowf()}.xlsx"))
```

[`write_excel()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/write_excel.md)
writes an xlsx meant to be opened by a person: bold frozen header,
thousand separators, blank cells for `NA`.
[`f()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/f.md) is
[`glue::glue()`](https://glue.tidyverse.org/reference/glue.html) under a
shorter name, and
[`nowf()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/nowf.md) is a
formatted timestamp.

## Functions

| Function                                                                                                                                                                                      | Description                                                                                                                          |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `%??%`                                                                                                                                                                                        | Null-coalescing operator that returns a default when `x` is `NULL`, empty, all-`NA`, or all-`""`                                     |
| `%like%`                                                                                                                                                                                      | Regex matching that preserves `NA` (unlike `grepl`)                                                                                  |
| [`add_cpr_info()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/add_cpr_info.md)                                                                                                                 | Add birth date, age, sex, and validity derived from Danish CPR numbers                                                               |
| [`add_spell_status()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/add_spell_status.md)                                                                                                         | Add primo/ultimo status from spells to an existing panel, or the status on a date, without changing its rows                         |
| [`age()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/age.md)                                                                                                                                   | Choose the reference year or date for an age column in [`add_cpr_info()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/add_cpr_info.md) |
| [`clean_cpr()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/clean_cpr.md)                                                                                                                       | Standardise CPR numbers: strip separators, restore Excel-lost leading zeros                                                          |
| [`clean_cvr()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/clean_cvr.md)                                                                                                                       | Standardise CVR numbers: strip separators and the DK VAT prefix                                                                      |
| [`format_db07()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/format_db07.md)                                                                                                                   | Automatically handle mixed DB07 input; choose dotted (`01.11.00`) or compact (`011100`) output                                       |
| [`db_label()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/db_label.md)                                                                                                                         | Look up Danish industry labels with an explicit DB07 or DB25 version                                                                 |
| [`inspect_db()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/inspect_db.md)                                                                                                                     | Inspect mixed full DB07/DB25 codes; flag shared codes and show both labels                                                           |
| [`convert_db07_to_db25()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/convert_db07_to_db25.md) / [`convert_db25_to_db07()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/convert_db07_to_db25.md) | Convert full industry codes using DST’s bundled keys; strict or simplified mapping                                                   |
| [`drop_empty_rows()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/drop_empty_rows.md)                                                                                                           | Drop rows empty across selected columns; optionally include blank text                                                               |
| [`drop_empty_cols()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/drop_empty_rows.md)                                                                                                           | Drop entirely empty selected columns                                                                                                 |
| [`f()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/f.md)                                                                                                                                       | String interpolation shorthand ([`glue::glue`](https://glue.tidyverse.org/reference/glue.html) alias)                                |
| [`is_blank()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/is_blank.md)                                                                                                                         | Test whether a value is blank in the broadest sense                                                                                  |
| [`nowf()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/nowf.md)                                                                                                                                 | Formatted current timestamp, e.g. for file names                                                                                     |
| [`read_access()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/read_access.md)                                                                                                                   | Read data from a Microsoft Access database via ODBC                                                                                  |
| [`read_files()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/read_files.md)                                                                                                                     | Validate paths, read files (auto or custom reader), and optionally bind or unpack                                                    |
| [`read_ta()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/read_ta.md)                                                                                                                           | Read Greenlandic TA files (old layout)                                                                                               |
| [`write_ta()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/write_ta.md)                                                                                                                         | Write Greenlandic TA files (old layout)                                                                                              |
| [`read_ta2()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/read_ta2.md)                                                                                                                         | Read Greenlandic TA files (new 140-character layout)                                                                                 |
| [`write_ta2()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/write_ta2.md)                                                                                                                       | Write Greenlandic TA files (new 140-character layout)                                                                                |
| [`screen_timeseries()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/screen_timeseries.md)                                                                                                       | Fast interactive time-series screening with optional in-app diagnostics and seasonal plots                                           |
| [`diagnose_timeseries()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/diagnose_timeseries.md)                                                                                                   | Time-series statistics, seasonal/outlier screening, stationarity and structural breaks, optionally by group                          |
| [`shh()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/shh.md)                                                                                                                                   | Suppress messages and warnings during evaluation                                                                                     |
| [`split_by()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/split_by.md)                                                                                                                         | Split a data frame into a named list by grouping columns                                                                             |
| [`spells_to_panel()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/spells_to_panel.md)                                                                                                           | Turn spells (education, addresses) into a yearly/quarterly/monthly panel with primo and ultimo status                                |
| [`summon()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/summon.md)                                                                                                                             | Retrieve objects matching a regex pattern from an environment                                                                        |
| [`write_excel()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/write_excel.md)                                                                                                                   | Format xlsx with configurable `digits`; choose `new`, `append`, `replace` (sheets), or `overwrite` (whole file)                      |

# Package index

## General utilities

- [`f()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/f.md) : String
  interpolation shorthand

- [`nowf()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/nowf.md) :
  Formatted timestamp for now

- [`shh()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/shh.md) : Suppress
  messages and warnings

- [`is_blank()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/is_blank.md)
  : Test whether a value is "blank"

- [`` `%??%` ``](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/grapes-help-help-grapes.md)
  : Extended null-coalescing operator

- [`` `%like%` ``](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/grapes-like-grapes.md)
  :

  Regex matching with `NA` preservation

## File workflow

- [`read_files()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/read_files.md)
  : Read one or more files
- [`read_access()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/read_access.md)
  : Read data from a Microsoft Access database
- [`summon()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/summon.md) :
  Retrieve objects matching a pattern from an environment
- [`write_excel()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/write_excel.md)
  : Write data frames to a presentable Excel file

## Data wrangling

- [`diagnose_timeseries()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/diagnose_timeseries.md)
  : Diagnose time series, optionally within dplyr groups
- [`drop_empty_rows()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/drop_empty_rows.md)
  [`drop_empty_cols()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/drop_empty_rows.md)
  : Drop rows or columns that are empty in selected columns
- [`split_by()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/split_by.md)
  : Split a data frame into a named list by grouping columns
- [`spells_to_panel()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/spells_to_panel.md)
  : Turn spell data into a period panel with primo and ultimo status
- [`add_spell_status()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/add_spell_status.md)
  : Add status from spell data to a panel you already have

## Validation checkpoints

The checkpoints and their helpers have moved to the expectr package.
daos forwards them for existing scripts.

- [`expect_empty()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/moved-to-expectr.md)
  [`expect_none()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/moved-to-expectr.md)
  [`expect_unique()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/moved-to-expectr.md)
  [`expect_balanced()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/moved-to-expectr.md)
  [`expect_no_overlap()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/moved-to-expectr.md)
  [`tally_violations()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/moved-to-expectr.md)
  [`flag_duplicates()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/moved-to-expectr.md)
  [`view_types()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/moved-to-expectr.md)
  : Checkpoints, now in the expectr package

## Interactive

- [`screen_timeseries()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/screen_timeseries.md)
  : Interactive time-series screening dashboard

## Danish and Greenlandic data

- [`clean_cpr()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/clean_cpr.md)
  : Standardise CPR numbers
- [`add_cpr_info()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/add_cpr_info.md)
  : Add information derived from Danish CPR numbers
- [`age()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/age.md) : Specify
  an age calculation for CPR information
- [`clean_cvr()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/clean_cvr.md)
  : Standardise CVR numbers
- [`format_db07()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/format_db07.md)
  : Format DB07 industry codes
- [`convert_db07_to_db25()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/convert_db07_to_db25.md)
  [`convert_db25_to_db07()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/convert_db07_to_db25.md)
  : Convert industry codes between DB07 and DB25 using Statistics
  Denmark's keys
- [`db_label()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/db_label.md)
  : Look up Danish industry labels for DB07 or DB25 codes
- [`inspect_db()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/inspect_db.md)
  : Inspect possible classifications of mixed DB07 and DB25 industry
  codes
- [`read_ta()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/read_ta.md) :
  Read a Greenlandic TA file
- [`write_ta()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/write_ta.md)
  : Write a Greenlandic TA file
- [`read_ta2()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/read_ta2.md)
  : Read a Greenlandic TA file in the new layout
- [`write_ta2()`](https://dataniel.github.io/daos/reference/write_ta2.md)
  : Write a Greenlandic TA file in the new layout
